tagline: Your server's storage — private file manager
description:
Private self-hosted file storage for your homelab. Upload, organize,
preview and share files through a clean web UI. Files stay as normal
files on your server disk — no sync client, no cloud, no Nextcloud complexity.

tips.before_install: Pick your storage location (default /DATA/AppData/vaultora/files) and set a strong admin password.
tips.after_install: Open the app and log in with your admin user. Updates appear as an Update button on this app.

author: moresonsunn
